rows.text: Excess pressure tends to wear the center of the tread; shoulder wear is typical of insufficient pressure.
evidence: Michelin, What pressure for your tyres?: https://africa.michelin.com/en/auto/advice/tyre-pressure/what-tyre-pressure — sovrapressione al centro, pressione insufficiente sulle spalle.

rows.text: Slip angle is the angle between the direction the wheel points and the direction it travels, not an angle between two vehicle axles.
evidence: Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: The periodic inspection checks tire condition and wear, among other things. Tire slip angle arises while driving under lateral force and is not a measurement specified in the periodic tire inspection.
evidence: Direttiva 2014/45/UE, allegato I, punto 5.2.3: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2014/45/oj — ispezione visiva dei pneumatici e relative anomalie.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: Greater rear than front slip characterizes oversteer: the rear tends to move toward the outside of the bend, rather than reducing that tendency.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: In oversteer the vehicle takes a tighter turn, but the rear wheels have the greater slip angle. Greater front slip instead characterizes understeer.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: Slip arises from the tire's elastic response to lateral cornering forces and can occur even on a well-maintained vehicle. Maintenance does not eliminate it.
evidence: Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE. Excessive understeer with loss of front grip can widen the path and reduce control. Mild understeer designed into a vehicle in its normal operating range is a different meaning and can make its response more predictable.
evidence: NHTSA 2007 ESC final rule, technical discussion pp. 306–307 and 313–316, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/ESC_FR_03_2007_0.pdf: distinguish designed understeer from excessive understeer and reduced steering response; technical discussion, not a claim of Italian law.
NHTSA heavy-vehicle ESC proposal https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/136_hvy_veh_esc_nprm.pdf, PDF p.21: severe understeer and front traction loss; proposal, not enacted rule.

rows.text: In an understeering vehicle, increasing speed in a bend increases the lateral force required, so more steering is needed to maintain the same path.
evidence: Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: When front slip exceeds rear slip, the front follows a wider path than the turn requested: this is understeer.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: In oversteer the rear tends to move outward and the vehicle rotates more than intended; if severe, it can spin.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

NHTSA, Heavy Vehicle ESC Preliminary Regulatory Impact Analysis, figura III-2: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/136_esc_hvy_veh_pria.pdf — il sovrasterzo può portare alla rotazione del veicolo.

rows.text: In oversteer the vehicle turns more than intended and the rear tends outward. Turning less than intended is understeer.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: Ineffective shock absorbers can alter wheel contact and response. In some conditions, particularly with a front defect, the vehicle can become more prone to understeer.
evidence: Deubel et al., Investigation and Phenomenological Modeling of Degraded Twin-Tube Shock Absorbers, §1: https://www.mdpi.com/2624-8921/7/1/26 — una prova con ammortizzatore anteriore degradato ha rilevato più rollio e sottosterzo.

rows.text: In oversteer rear slip exceeds front slip: the rear tends outward and the vehicle takes a tighter turn than intended.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: Running wide is typical of understeer. In oversteer, the rear tends outward and the vehicle turns more than intended.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: Slip angle is related to lateral force and tire deformation in a bend; it does not arise solely from driving force or only on driven front wheels.
evidence: Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: A rear load does not always increase understeer: by changing tire response, it can also shift the vehicle toward oversteer.
evidence: NHTSA, ESV 2007, Light Commercial Vehicles: https://www-nrd.nhtsa.dot.gov/pdf/ESV/Proceedings/20/07-0269-O.pdf — nel veicolo studiato un carico sull’asse posteriore cambia la risposta da sottosterzante a sovrasterzante.

rows.text: Pressure changes tire deformation and its response to lateral forces, so it also affects slip angle in a bend.
evidence: John C. Dixon, Tires, Suspension and Handling, p.68 / PDF p.83 and §2.15.7 p.117 / PDF p.132, https://staff.emu.edu.tr/alexanderchefranov/Documents/CMSE443/CMSE443%20Fall%202023/pdfcoffee.com_tires-suspension-and-handling-1-56091-831-4-pdf-free.pdf: lateral force depends on slip angle and inflation pressure; cornering stiffness changes with pressure and tire design. Directly inspected university-hosted textbook copy, not an axle-specific conclusion.

rows.text: In understeer the front deviates more than the rear and the vehicle follows a wider curve than the steering input calls for.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: If the rear wheels have more slip than the front wheels, the rear tends outward and the vehicle turns more than intended: this is oversteer.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.

rows.text: In a bend, lateral force deforms the tire and its actual direction of travel differs from its orientation. This difference is the slip angle.
evidence: Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: In oversteer the rear tends outward and the vehicle turns more than intended. Load distribution can contribute to changing this behavior.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.
NHTSA, ESV 2007, Light Commercial Vehicles: https://www-nrd.nhtsa.dot.gov/pdf/ESV/Proceedings/20/07-0269-O.pdf — la distribuzione del carico modifica il comportamento direzionale.

rows.text: Pressure affects tire deformation and lateral response, and therefore slip angle too: the angle is not independent of pressure.
evidence: John C. Dixon, Tires, Suspension and Handling, p.68 / PDF p.83 and §2.15.7 p.117 / PDF p.132, https://staff.emu.edu.tr/alexanderchefranov/Documents/CMSE443/CMSE443%20Fall%202023/pdfcoffee.com_tires-suspension-and-handling-1-56091-831-4-pdf-free.pdf: lateral force depends on slip angle and inflation pressure; cornering stiffness changes with pressure and tire design. Directly inspected university-hosted textbook copy, not an axle-specific conclusion.

rows.text: Understeer does not cancel slip: it describes behavior in which the front wheels have greater slip than the rear wheels.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE, but slope alone does not always predict understeer: the vehicle, load and grip matter. Under some steady uphill conditions, rearward load transfer can instead increase the tendency to understeer.
evidence: John C. Dixon, Tires, Suspension and Handling, §6.18, printed pp.410–412 / PDF pp.425–427, https://staff.emu.edu.tr/alexanderchefranov/Documents/CMSE443/CMSE443%20Fall%202023/pdfcoffee.com_tires-suspension-and-handling-1-56091-831-4-pdf-free.pdf: steady-speed uphill model has rearward load transfer and increased primary understeer; certain specified final-handling model also increases. University-hosted copy of author textbook; not proof of a universal outcome.

Chalmers Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3, https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf: handling depends on vehicle and operating conditions; steady-state and transient understeer have distinct definitions.

rows.text: In understeer the front tends to run wide, so the vehicle turns less than requested by the steering input.
evidence: Michelin, Tire Glossary, Overinflation, Oversteer and Understeer: https://middle-east.michelin.com/en/auto/assistance/glossary — sovrapressione consuma il centro; sovrasterzo e sottosterzo dipendono dalla deriva relativa degli assi.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — deriva relativa degli assi e risposta in curva al crescere della velocità.

issues.reason: Il quesito stampa FALSO per un aumento della stabilità dovuto al sottosterzo, ma non distingue il lieve sottosterzo progettuale dalla perdita di controllo per sottosterzo eccessivo. Le fonti indicano entrambi i casi; manca il contesto per conciliarli con il verdetto.
checked_sources: NHTSA, Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards, Electronic Stability Control Systems, p. 96: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/ESC_FR_03_2007_0.pdf — veicoli leggeri progettati con sottosterzo nel campo lineare.
NHTSA, Heavy Vehicle ESC NPRM: https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/136_hvy_veh_esc_nprm.pdf — il sottosterzo grave può causare perdita di controllo direzionale.

issues.reason: Il quiz stampa FALSO per aumento del sottosterzo in curva in salita, ma una fonte tecnica descrive un aumento del sottosterzo primario su salita a velocità costante. Non è specificato un contesto che risolva il conflitto.
checked_sources: Dixon, Tires, Suspension and Handling, §6.18 Hills, p. 410: https://staff.emu.edu.tr/alexanderchefranov/Documents/CMSE443/CMSE443%20Fall%202023/pdfcoffee.com_tires-suspension-and-handling-1-56091-831-4-pdf-free.pdf — il trasferimento del carico verso il retro in salita aumenta il sottosterzo primario.
Chalmers, Vehicle Dynamics Compendium, §4.3.3: https://research.chalmers.se/publication/520229/file/520229_Fulltext.pdf — distingue gradiente di sottosterzo e comportamento transitorio.
